sources.title: Next-Latent Prediction Transformers Learn Compact World Models
sources.snippet: This objective drives the transformer to form compact latent summaries of past information with recurrent-like dynamics. In effect, NextLat enables the transformer to learn a compact internal world model while avoiding the sequential processing overhead of recurrent architectures.

sources.title: Next-Latent Prediction Transformers Learn Compact World Models
sources.snippet: NextLat addresses this gap by explicitly learning a latent dynamics model that governs how the transformer's latent states evolve given new tokens (i.e., "actions"), enabling the transformer to learn compact latent abstractions of the world with consistent dynamics. Beyond Next-Token Prediction.
